p1.title: Generic JSON patches mutate authoritative Reality
p1.narrative: Production replay applies generic checkpoint JSON patches instead of a closed set of complete typed domain transitions, weakening authoritative event validation.

p1.title: Cognitive prose participates in canonical replay
p1.narrative: Sponsor event payloads and replay depend on raw command receipts and decision records, so changing an explanation can alter otherwise identical authoritative replay.

p1.title: Causal edges admit noncausal relations
p1.narrative: Temporal predecessors and allegations can enter causalParents without a per-edge mechanism or strict parent existence and precedence validation.

p1.title: Catch-up has no durable operation protocol
p1.narrative: Active production catch-up recomputes from genesis behind a process-local flag and cannot resume an idempotent durable operation after interruption.
